Question 18
?

Find the general solution of the differential equation y′=ysin⁡(xy)+32y−xsin⁡(xy), with the initial condition y(0)=1.

a
cos⁡(xy)+y2−3x=2
b
(y2−3x)cos⁡(xy)=1
c
y2−sin⁡(x+y)−3x+sin⁡(1)−1=0
d
−cos⁡(xy)−y2+3x=−2
e
y2−cos⁡(xy)−3x=0
Submit
